'use client';

import { useState, KeyboardEvent, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { PaperAirplaneIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/solid';

interface ChatInputProps {
  onSendMessage: (message: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
}

export default function ChatInput({
  onSendMessage,
  disabled = false,
  placeholder = "Parlez avec Zangetsu..."
}: ChatInputProps) {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (message.trim() && !disabled) {
      onSendMessage(message.trim());
      setMessage('');
      // Reset textarea height
      if (textareaRef.current) {
        textareaRef.current.style.height = 'auto';
      }
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSend();
    }
  };

  // Auto-resize textarea
  useEffect(() => {
    if (textareaRef.current) {
      textareaRef.current.style.height = 'auto';
      textareaRef.current.style.height = `${Math.min(textareaRef.current.scrollHeight, 150)}px`;
    }
  }, [message]);

  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-lg">
      <div className="flex items-end gap-3">
        <textarea
          ref={textareaRef}
          value={message}
          onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          disabled={disabled}
          rows={1}
          className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-foreground placeholder:text-foreground-muted resize-none outline-none border-none focus:ring-0 max-h-[150px] overflow-y-auto"
          style={{ minHeight: '24px' }}
        />
        <button
          onClick={handleSend}
          disabled={disabled || !message.trim()}
          className="btn-primary flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-full p-0 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shrink-0"
          aria-label="Envoyer le message"
        >
          {disabled ? (
            <div className="spinner" />
          ) : (
            <PaperAirplaneIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 text-xs text-foreground-muted">
        <span>Shift + Enter pour nouvelle ligne</span>
        <span className={message.length > 500 ? 'text-cyber-pink' : ''}>
          {message.length}/1000
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { format } from 'date-fns';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export interface Message {
  id: string;
  content: string;
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  timestamp: Date;
}

interface ChatMessageProps {
  message: Message;
}

export default function ChatMessage({ message }: ChatMessageProps) {
  const isUser = message.role === 'user';

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
      className={`flex w-full mb-4 ${isUser ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
    >
      <div className={`flex flex-col ${isUser ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'} max-w-[80%]`}>
        <div className={isUser ? 'message-user' : 'message-ai'}>
          <div className="prose prose-invert prose-sm max-w-none">
            <ReactMarkdown
              components={{
                p: ({ children }) => <p className="mb-2 last:mb-0">{children}</p>,
                code: ({ children }) => (
                  <code className="bg-black/30 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono">
                    {children}
                  </code>
                ),
                pre: ({ children }) => (
                  <pre className="bg-black/30 p-3 rounded-lg overflow-x-auto my-2">
                    {children}
                  </pre>
                ),
              }}
            >
              {message.content}
            </ReactMarkdown>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/50 mt-1 px-2">
          {format(message.timestamp, 'HH:mm')}
        </span>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { listNFTs, generateNFTs, getDemoNFTs, type NFT as NFTAPI } from "@/lib/api/nft";

interface NFT {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  image: string;
  rarity: string;
  powerType: string;
  openseaUrl?: string;
  attributes: {
    title: string;
    power: number;
    speed: number;
    accuracy: number;
    intelligence: number;
  };
}

interface SelectedNFT {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  image: string;
  rarity: string;
  powerType: string;
  openseaUrl?: string;
  attributes: {
    title: string;
    power: number;
    speed: number;
    accuracy: number;
    intelligence: number;
  };
}

export default function NFTGallery() {
  const [nfts, setNfts] = useState<NFT[]>([]);
  const [selectedNFT, setSelectedNFT] = useState<SelectedNFT | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [minting, setMinting] = useState(false);
  const [mintSuccess, setMintSuccess] = useState<{ tokenId: string; nftName: string } | null>(null);

  // Load NFTs on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadNFTs = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        let data: NFTAPI[];

        try {
          data = await listNFTs();
        } catch (err) {
          // Fallback to demo NFTs if backend is unavailable
          console.warn("Backend unavailable, using demo NFTs");
          data = getDemoNFTs();
        }

        const formatted: NFT[] = data.map((nft: NFTAPI) => ({
          id: nft.id,
          name: nft.name,
          description: nft.description,
          image: nft.image,
          rarity: nft.rarity,
          powerType: nft.powerType,
          openseaUrl: nft.openseaUrl,
          attributes: {
            title: nft.attributes?.title || "",
            power: nft.attributes?.power || 0,
            speed: nft.attributes?.speed || 0,
            accuracy: nft.attributes?.accuracy || 0,
            intelligence: nft.attributes?.intelligence || 0,
          },
        }));

        setNfts(formatted);
        setError(null);
      } catch (err) {
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to load NFTs");
        setNfts([]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadNFTs();
  }, []);

  const handleGenerateNFTs = async () => {
    try {
      setGenerating(true);
      setError(null);

      try {
        await generateNFTs();
      } catch (err) {
        // Silently fail if backend not available
        console.warn("Backend unavailable for generation, using demo NFTs");
      }

      // Reload NFTs
      let data: NFTAPI[];
      try {
        data = await listNFTs();
      } catch (err) {
        data = getDemoNFTs();
      }

      const formatted: NFT[] = data.map((nft: NFTAPI) => ({
        id: nft.id,
        name: nft.name,
        description: nft.description,
        image: nft.image,
        rarity: nft.rarity,
        powerType: nft.powerType,
        attributes: {
          title: nft.attributes?.title || "",
          power: nft.attributes?.power || 0,
          speed: nft.attributes?.speed || 0,
          accuracy: nft.attributes?.accuracy || 0,
          intelligence: nft.attributes?.intelligence || 0,
        },
      }));

      setNfts(formatted);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to generate NFTs");
    } finally {
      setGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMintNFT = async () => {
    if (!selectedNFT) return;

    try {
      setMinting(true);
      setError(null);
      setMintSuccess(null);

      // Simulate minting delay (2 seconds)
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

      // Generate random token ID
      const tokenId = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000)
        .toString()
        .padStart(5, "0");

      // Show success message
      setMintSuccess({
        tokenId,
        nftName: selectedNFT.name,
      });

      // Auto-hide success after 5 seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        setMintSuccess(null);
      }, 5000);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to mint NFT");
    } finally {
      setMinting(false);
    }
  };

  const rarityColor = (rarity: string) => {
    switch (rarity.toLowerCase()) {
      case "legendary":
        return "text-yellow-400 border-yellow-400";
      case "epic":
        return "text-purple-400 border-purple-400";
      case "rare":
        return "text-blue-400 border-blue-400";
      default:
        return "text-gray-400 border-gray-400";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-8 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-[#DAA520] to-[#16f4d0] bg-clip-text text-transparent mb-2">
            🎨 NFT Gallery
          </h2>
          <p className="text-gray-400">
            {loading ? "Loading agents..." : `Explore your generated BMAD Super-Agents. ${nfts.length} agents available.`}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleGenerateNFTs}
          disabled={generating || loading}
          className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-[#DAA520] to-[#16f4d0] text-gray-900 font-bold hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-[#16f4d0]/50 transition-all duration-300 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          {generating ? "Generating..." : "Generate NFTs"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-lg bg-red-900/20 border border-red-700 text-red-400">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {loading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-96">
          <div className="text-center">
            <p className="text-gray-400 mb-2">⏳ Loading NFTs from backend...</p>
            <p className="text-gray-600 text-sm">Making sure Nosferatu agents are ready</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {/* NFT Cards */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2">
            {nfts.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-900 to-gray-800 p-8 text-center">
                <p className="text-gray-400 mb-4">No NFTs generated yet</p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleGenerateNFTs}
                  disabled={generating}
                  className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-[#DAA520] to-[#16f4d0] text-gray-900 font-bold hover:shadow-lg"
                >
                  Generate First NFTs
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {nfts.map((nft) => (
                  <div
                    key={nft.id}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedNFT(nft)}
                    className={`cursor-pointer rounded-lg overflow-hidden border transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 ${
                      selectedNFT?.id === nft.id
                        ? "border-[#16f4d0] shadow-lg shadow-[#16f4d0]/50 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#16f4d0]/10 to-transparent"
                        : "border-gray-700 hover:border-[#DAA520] bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-900 to-gray-800"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Image Container */}
                    <div className="relative w-full h-64 bg-gray-950 overflow-hidden">
                      <Image
                        src={nft.image}
                        alt={nft.name}
                        fill
                        className="object-cover"
                        priority={selectedNFT?.id === nft.id}
                      />
                      {/* Rarity Badge */}
                      <div className={`absolute top-3 right-3 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border ${rarityColor(nft.rarity)} text-sm font-semibold`}>
                        {nft.rarity}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Card Info */}
                    <div className="p-4">
                      <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-lg mb-1">
                        {nft.name}
                      </h3>
                      <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm line-clamp-2">
                        {nft.description}
                      </p>
                      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-[#16f4d0] text-sm font-semibold">
                          {nft.powerType}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-gray-500 text-xs">#{nft.id}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Detail Panel */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-1">
            {selectedNFT ? (
              <div className="sticky top-4 rounded-lg border border-[#16f4d0] bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-900 via-gray-950 to-gray-900 p-6 shadow-lg shadow-[#16f4d0]/20">
                {/* Selected NFT Image */}
                <div className="relative w-full h-72 rounded-lg overflow-hidden mb-6 border border-gray-700">
                  <Image
                    src={selectedNFT.image}
                    alt={selectedNFT.name}
                    fill
                    className="object-cover"
                    priority
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Info */}
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-1">
                      {selectedNFT.name}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[#16f4d0] font-semibold text-sm mb-2">
                      {selectedNFT.attributes.title}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm leading-relaxed">
                      {selectedNFT.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Attributes */}
                  <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-gray-700 pt-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="text-gray-400">Rarity</span>
                      <span className={`font-bold ${rarityColor(selectedNFT.rarity).split(" ")[0]}`}>
                        {selectedNFT.rarity}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Stats Bars */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      {[
                        { label: "Speed", value: selectedNFT.attributes.speed },
                        { label: "Accuracy", value: selectedNFT.attributes.accuracy },
                        { label: "Intelligence", value: selectedNFT.attributes.intelligence },
                      ].map((stat) => (
                        <div key={stat.label}>
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
                            <span className="text-gray-400 text-sm">{stat.label}</span>

                              style={{ width: `${stat.value}%` }}

                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-t border-gray-700 pt-3">

FILE: ui/components/TransactionPanel.tsx

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PaperAirplaneIcon, ArrowPathIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/outline';
import { CheckCircleIcon, XCircleIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/solid';
import { sendTokens, getWalletBalance, formatBalance, CHAIN_IDS, getChainName } from '@/lib/transactions';

interface TransactionPanelProps {
  walletAddress: string;
  chainId?: number;
}

export default function TransactionPanel({
  walletAddress,
  chainId = CHAIN_IDS.BASE_SEPOLIA
}: TransactionPanelProps) {
  const [recipient, setRecipient] = useState('');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [txStatus, setTxStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [txMessage, setTxMessage] = useState('');
  const [balance, setBalance] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSendTokens = async () => {
    if (!recipient || !amount) {
      setTxStatus('error');
      setTxMessage('Veuillez remplir tous les champs');
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setTxStatus('idle');
    setTxMessage('');

    try {
      const result = await sendTokens({
        to: recipient,
        amount: (parseFloat(amount) * 1e18).toString(), // Convert to wei
        chainId,
        from: walletAddress,
      });

      setTxStatus('success');
      setTxMessage(`Transaction envoyée! ID: ${result.transactionIds[0]}`);
      setRecipient('');
      setAmount('');

      // Refresh balance
      await loadBalance();
    } catch (error: any) {
      setTxStatus('error');
      setTxMessage(error.message || 'Erreur lors de l\'envoi');
      console.error('Transaction failed:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadBalance = async () => {
    try {
      const balanceData = await getWalletBalance({
        address: walletAddress,
        chainId,
      });

      setBalance(formatBalance(balanceData.balance, balanceData.decimals));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load balance:', error);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold cyber-gradient-text">Envoyer des Tokens</h3>
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground-muted">
          {getChainName(chainId)} • Gas Sponsorisé ✨
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Balance Display */}
      <div className="glass rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-foreground-muted">Solde</p>
          <p className="text-xl font-bold">
            {balance !== null ? `${balance} ETH` : 'Chargement...'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={loadBalance}
          className="btn-secondary px-3 py-2 text-sm"
          disabled={isLoading}
        >
          <ArrowPathIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Recipient Input */}
      <div>
        <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">
          Adresse du destinataire
        </label>
        <input
          type="text"
          value={recipient}
          onChange={(e) => setRecipient(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="0x..."
          className="w-full bg-background-secondary border border-glass-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-foreground placeholder:text-foreground-muted focus:border-alexandria-accent focus:ring-2 focus:ring-alexandria-accent/20 transition-all"
          disabled={isLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Amount Input */}
      <div>
        <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">
          Montant (ETH)
        </label>
        <input
          type="number"
          value={amount}
          onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="0.0"
          step="0.001"
          min="0"
          className="w-full bg-background-secondary border border-glass-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-foreground placeholder:text-foreground-muted focus:border-alexandria-accent focus:ring-2 focus:ring-alexandria-accent/20 transition-all"
          disabled={isLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Send Button */}
      <button
        onClick={handleSendTokens}
        disabled={isLoading || !recipient || !amount}
        className="btn-primary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
      >
        {isLoading ? (
          <>
            <div className="spinner" />
            <span>Envoi en cours...</span>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <PaperAirplaneIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span>Envoyer (Gas Gratuit)</span>
          </>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* Status Message */}
      {txStatus !== 'idle' && (
        <div
          className={`glass rounded-lg p-4 flex items-start gap-3 ${
            txStatus === 'success' ? 'border-cyber-green' : 'border-cyber-pink'
          } border`}
        >
          {txStatus === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircleIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-cyber-green shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          ) : (
            <XCircleIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-cyber-pink shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          )}
          <p className="text-sm">{txMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Info */}
      <div className="glass rounded-lg p-3 text-xs text-foreground-muted">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-cyber-green">✓</span>
          Les frais de gas sont automatiquement sponsorisés via EIP-7702
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { WalletIcon, ArrowRightOnRectangleIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/outline';
import { CheckCircleIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/solid';

interface WalletConnectProps {
  onConnect?: (address: string) => void;
  onDisconnect?: () => void;
}

export default function WalletConnect({ onConnect, onDisconnect }: WalletConnectProps) {
  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);
  const [walletAddress, setWalletAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isConnecting, setIsConnecting] = useState(false);

  const handleConnect = async () => {
    setIsConnecting(true);

    try {
      // TODO: Implement thirdweb wallet connection
      // For now, simulate connection
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));

      const mockAddress = '0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b8D43C67B8c8B3E9C6';
      setWalletAddress(mockAddress);
      setIsConnected(true);
      onConnect?.(mockAddress);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to connect wallet:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsConnecting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDisconnect = () => {
    setWalletAddress(null);
    setIsConnected(false);
    onDisconnect?.();
  };

  const truncateAddress = (address: string) => {
    return `${address.slice(0, 6)}...${address.slice(-4)}`;
  };

  if (isConnected && walletAddress) {
    return (
      <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircleIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-cyber-green" />
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-xs text-foreground-muted">Connecté</span>
            <span className="text-sm font-mono font-semibold text-foreground">
              {truncateAddress(walletAddress)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={handleDisconnect}
          className="btn-secondary px-3 py-2 text-sm flex items-center gap-2 hover-glow"
          aria-label="Déconnecter le wallet"
        >
          <ArrowRightOnRectangleIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Déconnecter</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleConnect}
      disabled={isConnecting}
      className="btn-primary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed animate-pulse-glow"
      aria-label="Connecter le wallet"
    >
      {isConnecting ? (
        <>
          <div className="spinner" />
          <span>Connexion...</span>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <WalletIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
          <span>Connecter Wallet</span>
        </>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Listing } from "@/lib/contracts";
import { formatEther } from "viem";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { useBuyListing } from "@/hooks/marketplace/useBuyListing";
import { useState } from "react";

interface ListingCardProps {
  listing: Listing;
  onBuySuccess?: () => void;
}

export function ListingCard({ listing, onBuySuccess }: ListingCardProps) {
  const { buyFromListing, isBuying, error } = useBuyListing();
  const [showBuyConfirm, setShowBuyConfirm] = useState(false);

  const handleBuy = async () => {
    try {
      await buyFromListing(
        listing.listingId,
        listing.quantity,
        listing.currencyContract,
        listing.buyoutPricePerToken * listing.quantity
      );
      setShowBuyConfirm(false);
      onBuySuccess?.();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Purchase failed:", err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className="bg-gradient-to-br from-[#000428] to-[#004e92] p-6 rounded-xl border border-[#DAA520]/30 shadow-xl hover:shadow-[#DAA520]/20 transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#DAA520]/60"
    >
      {/* NFT Placeholder */}
      <div className="aspect-square bg-gradient-to-br from-[#004e92] to-[#000428] rounded-lg mb-4 flex items-center justify-center border border-[#DAA520]/20">
        <div className="text-6xl">🖼️</div>
      </div>

      {/* Token Info */}
      <div className="mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-white truncate flex-1">
            Token #{listing.tokenId.toString()}
          </h3>
          <span className="text-xs bg-[#DAA520]/20 text-[#DAA520] px-2 py-1 rounded ml-2 whitespace-nowrap">
            x{listing.quantity.toString()}
          </span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 truncate">
          Contract: {listing.assetContract.slice(0, 6)}...
          {listing.assetContract.slice(-4)}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Price Display */}
      <div className="mb-4">
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Price per Token</p>
        <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#16f4d0]">
          {formatEther(listing.buyoutPricePerToken)} ETH
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
          Total: {formatEther(listing.buyoutPricePerToken * listing.quantity)} ETH
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Seller Info */}
      <div className="mb-4 pb-4 border-b border-[#DAA520]/20">
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Seller</p>
        <p className="text-sm text-[#16f4d0] font-mono truncate">
          {listing.tokenOwner.slice(0, 6)}...{listing.tokenOwner.slice(-4)}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Buy Button */}
      {!showBuyConfirm ? (
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowBuyConfirm(true)}
          className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#DAA520] to-[#16f4d0] hover:from-[#DAA520]/90 hover:to-[#16f4d0]/90 text-[#000428] font-semibold px-4 py-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105"
        >
          🛒 Buy Now
        </button>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleBuy}
            disabled={isBuying}
            className="w-full bg-[#16f4d0] hover:bg-[#16f4d0]/90 disabled:opacity-50 text-[#000428] font-semibold px-4 py-3 rounded-lg transition-all"
          >
            {isBuying ? "Processing..." : "✅ Confirm Purchase"}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowBuyConfirm(false)}
            disabled={isBuying}
            className="w-full bg-[#004e92] hover:bg-[#004e92]/80 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-all"
          >
            ❌ Cancel
          </button>
          {error && <p className="text-xs text-red-400 text-center">{error}</p>}
        </div>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

FILE: ui/components/wallet/ConnectButton.tsx

"use client";

import { ConnectButton as ThirdwebConnect } from "thirdweb/react";
import { client, BASE_CHAIN, ALEXANDRIA_PARACHAIN } from "@/lib/thirdweb";
import { createWallet } from "thirdweb/wallets";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const wallets = [
  createWallet("io.metamask"),
  createWallet("com.coinbase.wallet"),
  createWallet("me.rainbow"),
];

export function ConnectButton() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [chain, setChain] = useState(BASE_CHAIN);
  const [useLocalChain, setUseLocalChain] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    // Check if we should use local chain (e.g., from URL param or localStorage)
    const localChain = localStorage.getItem("useLocalChain") === "true";
    setUseLocalChain(localChain);
    setChain(localChain ? ALEXANDRIA_PARACHAIN : BASE_CHAIN);
  }, []);

  const toggleChain = () => {
    const newValue = !useLocalChain;
    setUseLocalChain(newValue);
    setChain(newValue ? ALEXANDRIA_PARACHAIN : BASE_CHAIN);
    localStorage.setItem("useLocalChain", newValue ? "true" : "false");
  };

  if (!mounted) {
    return (
      <button
        disabled
        className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#000428] to-[#004e92] text-[#DAA520] font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-[#DAA520]/50 transition-all"
        style={{ height: "50px", minWidth: "165px" }}
      >
        Loading...
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="thirdweb-connect-wrapper flex gap-2 items-center" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#004e92]/30 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-[#DAA520]/30">
        <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">
          {useLocalChain ? "🌐 Local" : "🌐 BASE"}
        </span>
        <button
          onClick={toggleChain}
          className="text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#DAA520]/20 hover:bg-[#DAA520]/40 text-[#DAA520] transition-all"
        >
          Switch
        </button>
      </div>
      <ThirdwebConnect
        client={client}
        wallets={wallets}
        chain={chain}
        connectButton={{
          label: "Connect Wallet",
          className: "bg-gradient-to-r from-[#000428] to-[#004e92] text-[#DAA520] font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-[#DAA520]/50 transition-all",
        }}
        connectModal={{
          size: "wide",
          title: "🌑 Alexandria Wallet 🌸",
          titleIcon: "",
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useReadContract } from "thirdweb/react";

FILE: ui/hooks/arena/useBattleHistory.ts

import { useReadContract } from "thirdweb/react";
import { getArenaContract } from "@/lib/contracts";
import { useMemo } from "react";

/**
 * Get battle wins for an agent
 */
export function useBattleHistory(agentId: bigint) {
  const contract = getArenaContract();

  const { data: wins, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "agentWins",
    params: [agentId],
  });

  return {
    wins: wins ? Number(wins) : 0,
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Get battle losses for an agent
 */
export function useBattleLosses(agentId: bigint) {
  const contract = getArenaContract();

  const { data: losses, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "agentLosses",
    params: [agentId],
  });

  return {
    losses: losses ? Number(losses) : 0,
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Get total wins and losses (win rate)
 */
export function useBattleWinRate(agentId: bigint) {
  const { wins, isLoading: winsLoading } = useBattleHistory(agentId);
  const { losses, isLoading: lossesLoading } = useBattleLosses(agentId);

  const total = wins + losses;
  const winRate = total > 0 ? (wins / total) * 100 : 0;

  return {
    wins,
    losses,
    total,
    winRate,
    isLoading: winsLoading || lossesLoading,
  };
}

/**
 * Get agent earnings from battles
 */
export function useBattleEarnings(agentId: bigint) {
  const contract = getArenaContract();

  const { data: earnings, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "agentEarnings",
    params: [agentId],
  });

  return {
    earnings: earnings ? earnings.toString() : "0",
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Get all battle results for an agent
 */
export function useAgentBattles(agentId: bigint, limit: number = 10) {
  const contract = getArenaContract();

  const { data: battles, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "getAgentBattles",
    params: [agentId, 0n, BigInt(limit)],
  });

  return {
    battles: battles || [],
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Check if agent is eligible for rewards
 */
export function useRewardEligibility(agentId: bigint) {
  const contract = getArenaContract();

  const { data: isEligible, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "isEligibleForReward",
    params: [agentId],
  });

  return {
    isEligible: Boolean(isEligible),
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Get last battle timestamp
 */
export function useLastBattleTime(agentId: bigint) {
  const contract = getArenaContract();

  const { data: timestamp, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "lastBattleTime",
    params: [agentId],
  });

  const lastBattleDate = useMemo(() => {
    if (!timestamp) return null;
    return new Date(Number(timestamp) * 1000);
  }, [timestamp]);

  return {
    lastBattleTime: timestamp ? Number(timestamp) : 0,
    lastBattleDate,
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Get agent level and skills
 */
export function useAgentStats(agentId: bigint) {
  const contract = getArenaContract();

  const { data: level, isLoading: levelLoading } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "agentLevel",
    params: [agentId],
  });

  const { data: skills, isLoading: skillsLoading } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "getAgentSkills",
    params: [agentId],
  });

  return {
    level: level ? Number(level) : 0,
    skills: (skills as string[]) || [],
    isLoading: levelLoading || skillsLoading,
  };
}

/**
 * Get battle rating/ranking
 */
export function useBattleRating(agentId: bigint) {
  const contract = getArenaContract();

  const { data: rating, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract,
    method: "agentRating",
    params: [agentId],
  });

  return {
    rating: rating ? Number(rating) : 0,

import { useContractWrite, useReadContract } from "thirdweb/react";
import { getArenaContract } from "@/lib/contracts";
import { useState } from "react";

/**
 * Claim rewards earned from battles
 */
export function useClaimReward() {
  const contract = getArenaContract();
  const [isClaiming, setIsClaiming] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { mutateAsync: write } = useContractWrite({
    contract,
    method: "claimRewards",
  });

  const claimReward = async (agentId: bigint) => {
    try {
      setIsClaiming(true);
      setError(null);

      const result = await write({
        asyncParams: async () => [agentId],
      });

      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to claim rewards";
      setError(errorMessage);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsClaiming(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    claimReward,
    isClaiming,
    error,
  };
}

import { useContractWrite } from "thirdweb/react";
import { getMarketplaceContract } from "@/lib/contracts";
import { useState } from "react";

export interface CreateListingParams {
  assetContract: string;
  tokenId: bigint;
  quantity: bigint;
  currency: string;
  pricePerToken: bigint;
  expirationTimestamp: bigint;
  reserved: boolean;
  reservedBuyer?: string;
}

/**
 * Create a new listing on the marketplace
 */
export function useCreateListing() {
  const contract = getMarketplaceContract();
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { mutateAsync: write } = useContractWrite({
    contract: contract || undefined,
    method: "createListing",
  });

  const createListing = async (params: CreateListingParams) => {
    try {
      setIsCreating(true);
      setError(null);

      const result = await write({
        asyncParams: async () => {
          return [
            {
              assetContract: params.assetContract,
              tokenId: params.tokenId,
              quantity: params.quantity,
              currency: params.currency,
              pricePerToken: params.pricePerToken,
              expirationTimestamp: params.expirationTimestamp,
              reserved: params.reserved,
              reservedBuyer: params.reservedBuyer || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
            },
          ];
        },
      });

      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to create listing";
      setError(errorMessage);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsCreating(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    createListing,
    isCreating,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Update an existing listing
 */
export function useUpdateListing() {
  const contract = getMarketplaceContract();
  const [isUpdating, setIsUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { mutateAsync: write } = useContractWrite({
    contract: contract || undefined,
    method: "updateListing",
  });

  const updateListing = async (listingId: bigint, params: CreateListingParams) => {
    try {
      setIsUpdating(true);
      setError(null);

      const result = await write({
        asyncParams: async () => {
          return [
            listingId,
            {
              assetContract: params.assetContract,
              tokenId: params.tokenId,
              quantity: params.quantity,
              currency: params.currency,
              pricePerToken: params.pricePerToken,
              expirationTimestamp: params.expirationTimestamp,
              reserved: params.reserved,
              reservedBuyer: params.reservedBuyer || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
            },
          ];
        },
      });

      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to update listing";
      setError(errorMessage);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsUpdating(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    updateListing,
    isUpdating,
    error,
  };
}

 * Cancel a listing
 */
export function useCancelListing() {
  const contract = getMarketplaceContract();

import { useReadContract } from "thirdweb/react";
import { getMarketplaceContract, Listing } from "@/lib/contracts";
import { useMemo } from "react";

/**
 * Fetch all active listings from the marketplace
 * Returns paginated results for performance
 */
export function useListings(startId: bigint = 0n, endId: bigint = 100n) {
  const contract = getMarketplaceContract();

  const {
    data: listings,
    isLoading,
    error,
    refetch,
  } = useReadContract({
    contract: contract || undefined,
    method: "getAllListings",
    params: contract ? [startId, endId] : undefined,
  });

  return {
    listings: (listings as Listing[] | undefined) || [],
    isLoading,
    error,
    refetch,
  };
}

/**
 * Get total number of listings in the marketplace
 */
export function useTotalListings() {
  const contract = getMarketplaceContract();

  const { data: total, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract: contract || undefined,
    method: "totalListings",
    params: contract ? [] : undefined,
  });

  return {
    total: total ? Number(total) : 0,
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Get a specific listing by ID
 */
export function useListing(listingId: bigint) {
  const contract = getMarketplaceContract();

  const { data: listing, isLoading, error } = useReadContract({
    contract: contract || undefined,
    method: "getListing",
    params: contract ? [listingId] : undefined,
  });

  return {
    listing: listing as Listing | undefined,
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

/**
 * Get all listings for a specific seller
 */
export function useListingsByOwner(ownerAddress: string) {
  const contract = getMarketplaceContract();
  const { listings, isLoading } = useListings();

  const ownerListings = useMemo(() => {
    return listings.filter(
      (listing: Listing) => listing.tokenOwner.toLowerCase() === ownerAddress.toLowerCase()
    );
  }, [listings, ownerAddress]);

  return {
    listings: ownerListings,
    isLoading,
  };
}

/**
 * Get all listings for a specific asset contract
 */
export function useListingsByAsset(assetContract: string) {
  const contract = getMarketplaceContract();
  const { listings, isLoading } = useListings();

  const assetListings = useMemo(() => {
    return listings.filter(
      (listing: Listing) =>
        listing.assetContract.toLowerCase() === assetContract.toLowerCase()
    );
  }, [listings, assetContract]);

  return {
    listings: assetListings,
    isLoading,
  };
}

/**
 * Search listings with filters
 */
export function useSearchListings(
  filters: {
    minPrice?: bigint;
    maxPrice?: bigint;
    owner?: string;
    assetContract?: string;
    tokenId?: bigint;
  } = {}
) {
  const { listings, isLoading } = useListings();

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return listings.filter((listing: Listing) => {
      if (filters.minPrice && listing.buyoutPricePerToken < filters.minPrice) {
        return false;
      }
      if (filters.maxPrice && listing.buyoutPricePerToken > filters.maxPrice) {
        return false;
      }
      if (
        filters.owner &&
        listing.tokenOwner.toLowerCase() !== filters.owner.toLowerCase()
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (
        filters.assetContract &&
        listing.assetContract.toLowerCase() !== filters.assetContract.toLowerCase()
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (filters.tokenId && listing.tokenId !== filters.tokenId) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [listings, filters]);

  return {
    listings: filtered,
    isLoading,
  };
}

  nativeCurrency: {
    name: "Ether",
    symbol: "ETH",
    decimals: 18,

  testnet: true,
  blockExplorers: [
    {
      name: "BuildBear",
      url: "https://explorer.buildbear.io",
    },
  ],
});

/**
 * All supported chains for the wallet
 * Used for chain switching and multi-chain operations
 */
export const SUPPORTED_CHAINS = [BASE_CHAIN, BASE_SEPOLIA_CHAIN, BUILDBEAR_CHAIN];

/**
 * Get chain by ID
 */
export function getChainById(chainId: number) {
  return SUPPORTED_CHAINS.find((chain) => chain.id === chainId);
}

/**
 * Check if a chain is testnet
 */
export function isTestnet(chainId: number): boolean {
  const chain = getChainById(chainId);
  return chain?.testnet ?? false;
}

/**
 * Chat functionality and message management
 */

import { Message } from '@/components/ChatMessage';

export interface ChatHistory {
  messages: Message[];
  lastUpdated: Date;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'alexandria-chat-history';

export function saveChatHistory(messages: Message[]): void {
  try {
    const history: ChatHistory = {
      messages,
      lastUpdated: new Date(),
    };
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(history));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to save chat history:', error);
  }
}

export function loadChatHistory(): Message[] | null {
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!stored) return null;

    const history: ChatHistory = JSON.parse(stored);
    return history.messages.map(m => ({
      ...m,
      timestamp: new Date(m.timestamp),
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load chat history:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

export function clearChatHistory(): void {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to clear chat history:', error);
  }
}

import { createThirdwebClient, defineChain } from "thirdweb";
import { base } from "thirdweb/chains";

if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_THIRDWEB_CLIENT_ID) {
  throw new Error("Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_THIRDWEB_CLIENT_ID");
}

// Define local Polkadot Parachain
export const ALEXANDRIA_PARACHAIN = defineChain({
  id: 2000, // Local dev chain ID
  name: "Alexandria Parachain",
  nativeCurrency: { name: "ALEX", symbol: "ALEX", decimals: 18 },
  rpc: "http://localhost:9944",
  testnet: true,
});

// Define the API URL
const THIRDWEB_API_URL = "https://api.thirdweb.com";

// Define the ThirdwebClient class
class ThirdwebClient {
  private clientId: string;

  constructor(clientId: string) {
    this.clientId = clientId;
  }

  private getHeaders(): HeadersInit {
    return {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "x-client-id": this.clientId,
    };
  }

  // TODO: Add AI agent methods
  async sendAIMessage(message: string, token?: string): Promise<any> {
    // This is a placeholder - actual AI endpoint needs to be determined
    // from thirdweb API documentation
    throw new Error('AI integration not yet implemented');
  }

  /**
   * Execute a sponsored contract write using EIP-7702
   * Gas fees are automatically sponsored by thirdweb infrastructure
   */
  async sponsoredContractWrite(params: {
    contractAddress: string;
    method: string;
    params: any[];
    chainId: number;
    from: string;
  }): Promise<{ transactionIds: string[] }> {
    const response = await fetch(`${THIRDWEB_API_URL}/v1/contracts/write`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: this.getHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({
        calls: [
          {
            contractAddress: params.contractAddress,
            method: params.method,
            params: params.params,
          },
        ],
        chainId: params.chainId,
        from: params.from,
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(`Sponsored transaction failed: ${error.message || response.statusText}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    return data.result;
  }

  /**
   * Execute a sponsored contract read
   */
  async sponsoredContractRead(params: {
    contractAddress: string;
    method: string;
    params: any[];
    chainId: number;
  }): Promise<any> {
    const response = await fetch(`${THIRDWEB_API_URL}/v1/contracts/read`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: this.getHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({
        contractAddress: params.contractAddress,
        method: params.method,
        params: params.params,
        chainId: params.chainId,
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(`Contract read failed: ${error.message || response.statusText}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    return data.result;
  }

  /**
   * Send tokens with sponsored gas fees
   */
  async sponsoredSendToken(params: {
    to: string;
    amount: string;
    tokenAddress?: string; // If not provided, sends native token (ETH, MATIC, etc.)
    chainId: number;
    from: string;
  }): Promise<{ transactionIds: string[] }> {
    if (params.tokenAddress) {
      // ERC20 transfer
      return this.sponsoredContractWrite({
        contractAddress: params.tokenAddress,
        method: 'function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)',
        params: [params.to, params.amount],
        chainId: params.chainId,
        from: params.from,
      });
    } else {
      // Native token transfer
      const response = await fetch(`${THIRDWEB_API_URL}/v1/contracts/write`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: this.getHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({
          calls: [
            {
              to: params.to,
              value: params.amount,
            },
          ],
          chainId: params.chainId,
          from: params.from,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(`Native token transfer failed: ${error.message || response.statusText}`);
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      return data.result;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Approve token spending with sponsored gas
   */
  async sponsoredApprove(params: {
    tokenAddress: string;
    spender: string;
    amount: string;
    chainId: number;
    from: string;
  }): Promise<{ transactionIds: string[] }> {
    return this.sponsoredContractWrite({
      contractAddress: params.tokenAddress,
      method: 'function approve(address spender, uint256 amount)',
      params: [params.spender, params.amount],
      chainId: params.chainId,
      from: params.from,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get transaction status
   */
  async getTransactionStatus(transactionId: string): Promise<any> {
    const response = await fetch(`${THIRDWEB_API_URL}/v1/transactions/${transactionId}`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: this.getHeaders(),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to get transaction status: ${response.statusText}`);
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  /**
   * Get wallet balance
   */
  async getBalance(params: {
    address: string;
    chainId: number;
    tokenAddress?: string; // If not provided, gets native token balance
  }): Promise<{ balance: string; decimals: number; symbol: string }> {
    const queryParams = new URLSearchParams({
      address: params.address,
      chainId: params.chainId.toString(),
    });

    if (params.tokenAddress) {
      queryParams.append('tokenAddress', params.tokenAddress);
    }

    const response = await fetch(`${THIRDWEB_API_URL}/v1/wallets/balance?${queryParams}`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: this.getHeaders(),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to get balance: ${response.statusText}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    return data.result;
  }
}

// Singleton instance
let thirdwebApiClient: ThirdwebClient | null = null;

export function initThirdwebApiClient(clientId?: string): ThirdwebClient {
  const id = clientId || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_THIRDWEB_CLIENT_ID;
  if (!id) {
    throw new Error('Thirdweb client ID is required');
  }
  thirdwebApiClient = new ThirdwebClient(id);
  return thirdwebApiClient;
}

export function getThirdwebClient(): ThirdwebClient {
  if (!thirdwebApiClient) {
    initThirdwebApiClient();
  }
  return thirdwebApiClient!;
}

export const client = createThirdwebClient({
  clientId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_THIRDWEB_CLIENT_ID,
});

/**
 * Format balance for display
 */
export function formatBalance(balance: string, decimals: number): string {
  const num = parseFloat(balance) / Math.pow(10, decimals);
  return num.toLocaleString('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 6,
  });
}

/**
 * Web3 Copilot API Client
 * Connects to the AI-powered smart contract analysis service
 * Located at: /blockchain/web3-copilot/
 * Default URL: http://localhost:8000
 */

const COPILOT_BASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB3_COPILOT_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

export interface ChatMessage {
  response: string;
  context?: {
    sources?: string[];
    confidence?: number;
  };
}

export interface ContractAnalysis {
  address: string;
  network: string;
  risk_level: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical";
  vulnerabilities: string[];
  recommendations: string[];
  analysis_timestamp: string;
}

export interface TransactionDebug {
  tx_hash: string;
  status: "success" | "failed" | "pending";
  reason?: string;
  suggestions?: string[];
}

/**
 * Web3 Copilot Client Class
 * Provides methods to interact with the AI contract analysis service
 */
export class Web3CopilotClient {
  private baseUrl: string;
  private apiKey?: string;

  constructor(baseUrl: string = COPILOT_BASE_URL, apiKey?: string) {
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
    this.apiKey = apiKey || process.env.WEB3_COPILOT_API_KEY;
  }

  /**
   * Send a chat message to the Copilot
   * Uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) for smart contract documentation
   */
  async chat(message: string): Promise<ChatMessage> {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...(this.apiKey && { Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}` }),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Web3 Copilot chat error:", error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Analyze a smart contract for security vulnerabilities
   * Uses Tenderly API and contract source code analysis
   */
  async analyzeContract(
    address: string,
    network: string = "base"
  ): Promise<ContractAnalysis> {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/api/analyze`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...(this.apiKey && { Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}` }),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          contract_address: address,
          network,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Web3 Copilot analysis error:", error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Debug a failed transaction
   * Analyzes transaction trace and suggests fixes
   */
  async debugTransaction(
    txHash: string,
    network: string = "base"
  ): Promise<TransactionDebug> {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/api/debug-tx`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...(this.apiKey && { Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}` }),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          tx_hash: txHash,
          network,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Web3 Copilot debug error:", error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Query documentation for a specific contract function
   */
  async queryDocumentation(contractName: string, functionName: string) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/api/docs`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...(this.apiKey && { Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}` }),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          contract: contractName,
          function: functionName,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Web3 Copilot docs error:", error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check service health
   */
  async health(): Promise<{ status: string; version: string }> {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/health`, {
        method: "GET",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Web3 Copilot health check error:", error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Global Copilot client instance
 * Singleton pattern for connection reuse
 */
export const copilotClient = new Web3CopilotClient();

/**
 * React Hook for Web3 Copilot integration
 * Provides client instance with error handling
 */
export function useWeb3Copilot() {
  const analyze = async (address: string) => {
    try {
      return await copilotClient.analyzeContract(address);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Contract analysis failed:", error);
      return null;
    }
  };

  const debug = async (txHash: string) => {
    try {
      return await copilotClient.debugTransaction(txHash);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Transaction debug failed:", error);
      return null;
    }
  };

  const chat = async (message: string) => {
    try {
      return await copilotClient.chat(message);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Chat failed:", error);
      return null;
    }
  };

  return { analyze, debug, chat };
}

#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Paths
DWALLSTREET="/home/ichigo/alexandria/anima-mundi/defense/alexandria-core/trading/dwallstreet/contracts"
ARENA="/home/ichigo/alexandria/anima-mundi/defense/alexandria-core/blockchain/web3-copilot/arena"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ABIS_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/../abis"

# Create directories
mkdir -p "$ABIS_DIR/dwallstreet"
mkdir -p "$ABIS_DIR/arena"

echo "📦 Compiling DWall Street contracts..."
cd "$DWALLSTREET"
if ! forge build 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "⚠️  Forge build failed. Make sure Foundry is installed and contracts are valid."
    echo "    Try: curl -L https://foundry.paradigm.xyz | bash && source ~/.bashrc && foundryup"
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Compilation successful!"

# Copy ABIs from DWall Street
echo "📋 Copying DWall Street ABIs..."
if [ -f "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/ERC20Base.sol/ERC20Base.json" ]; then
    jq '.abi' "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/ERC20Base.sol/ERC20Base.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/dwallstreet/ERC20Base.json"
    echo "  ✅ ERC20Base.json"
else
    echo "  ⚠️  ERC20Base.sol not found"
fi

if [ -f "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/ERC721Base.sol/ERC721Base.json" ]; then
    jq '.abi' "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/ERC721Base.sol/ERC721Base.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/dwallstreet/ERC721Base.json"
    echo "  ✅ ERC721Base.json"
else
    echo "  ⚠️  ERC721Base.sol not found"
fi

if [ -f "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/ERC1155Base.sol/ERC1155Base.json" ]; then
    jq '.abi' "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/ERC1155Base.sol/ERC1155Base.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/dwallstreet/ERC1155Base.json"
    echo "  ✅ ERC1155Base.json"
else
    echo "  ⚠️  ERC1155Base.sol not found"
fi

# Try different names for Marketplace contract
if [ -f "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/MarketplaceV3.sol/MarketplaceV3.json" ]; then
    jq '.abi' "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/MarketplaceV3.sol/MarketplaceV3.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/dwallstreet/MarketplaceV3.json"
    echo "  ✅ MarketplaceV3.json"
elif [ -f "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/Marketplace.sol/Marketplace.json" ]; then
    jq '.abi' "$DWALLSTREET/artifacts_forge/Marketplace.sol/Marketplace.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/dwallstreet/Marketplace.json"
    echo "  ✅ Marketplace.json"
else
    echo "  ⚠️  Marketplace contract not found"
fi

# Copy ABIs from Arena (if they exist)
echo "📋 Copying Arena ABIs..."
if [ -d "$ARENA/out" ]; then
    if [ -f "$ARENA/out/SuperAgentsNosferatu.sol/SuperAgentsNosferatu.json" ]; then
        jq '.abi' "$ARENA/out/SuperAgentsNosferatu.sol/SuperAgentsNosferatu.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/arena/SuperAgentsNosferatu.json"
        echo "  ✅ SuperAgentsNosferatu.json"
    elif [ -f "$ARENA/out/AgentsNFT.sol/AgentsNFT.json" ]; then
        jq '.abi' "$ARENA/out/AgentsNFT.sol/AgentsNFT.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/arena/SuperAgentsNosferatu.json"
        echo "  ✅ SuperAgentsNosferatu.json (from AgentsNFT.sol)"
    else
        echo "  ⚠️  AgentsNFT contract not found"
    fi

    if [ -f "$ARENA/out/Arena.sol/Arena.json" ]; then
        jq '.abi' "$ARENA/out/Arena.sol/Arena.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/arena/Arena.json"
        echo "  ✅ Arena.json"
    else
        echo "  ⚠️  Arena contract not found"
    fi

    if [ -f "$ARENA/out/AgentsHub.sol/AgentsHub.json" ]; then
        jq '.abi' "$ARENA/out/AgentsHub.sol/AgentsHub.json" > "$ABIS_DIR/arena/AgentsHub.json"
        echo "  ✅ AgentsHub.json"
    fi
else
    echo "  ⚠️  Arena out directory not found at $ARENA/out"
fi

echo ""
echo "🎉 ABIs copied successfully!"
echo "   Location: $ABIS_DIR"
ls -la "$ABIS_DIR"/dwallstreet 2>/dev/null || echo "   (No dwallstreet ABIs yet)"
ls -la "$ABIS_DIR"/arena 2>/dev/null || echo "   (No arena ABIs yet)"

import fs from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";
import { parse } from "csv-parse/sync";

/**
 * BMAD Methods Indexer
 * Scans all bmad-methods.csv files in the dwallstreet contracts
 * and creates a searchable index for API documentation
 */

const DWALLSTREET_ROOT =
  "/home/ichigo/alexandria/anima-mundi/defense/alexandria-core/trading/dwallstreet";
const OUTPUT_DIR = "./data";
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "bmad-methods.json");
const SUMMARY_FILE = path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "bmad-summary.json");

interface BMADMethod {
  method_id: string;
  method_name: string;
  description: string;
  category: string;
  file_path: string;
  line_number: number;
  type: string;
  source_file?: string;
  contract_name?: string;
}

interface ContractSummary {
  name: string;
  methods_count: number;
  methods: string[];
  path: string;
}

/**
 * Recursively find all bmad-methods.csv files
 */
async function findBMADFiles(dir: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const entries = await fs.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  const files: string[] = [];

  for (const entry of entries) {
    // Skip node_modules and hidden directories
    if (entry.name.startsWith(".") || entry.name === "node_modules") {
      continue;
    }

    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      const subFiles = await findBMADFiles(fullPath);
      files.push(...subFiles);
    } else if (entry.name === "bmad-methods.csv") {
      files.push(fullPath);
    }
  }

  return files;
}

/**
 * Extract contract name from file path
 */
function getContractName(filePath: string): string {
  // Extract contract name from path like:
  // contracts/prebuilts/marketplace/bmad-methods.csv -> "Marketplace"
  const parts = filePath.split(path.sep);
  const contractPath = parts.slice(parts.indexOf("contracts") + 1, -1);
  if (contractPath.length === 0) return "Root";

  return contractPath
    .map((p) => p.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + p.slice(1))
    .join("/");
}

/**
 * Main indexing function
 */
async function main() {
  console.log("📚 Starting BMAD Methods Indexing...\n");

  try {
    // Create output directory
    await fs.mkdir(OUTPUT_DIR, { recursive: true });

    // Find all CSV files
    const csvFiles = await findBMADFiles(DWALLSTREET_ROOT);
    console.log(`📁 Found ${csvFiles.length} bmad-methods.csv files\n`);

    if (csvFiles.length === 0) {
      console.warn("⚠️  No bmad-methods.csv files found!");
      return;
    }

    const allMethods: BMADMethod[] = [];
    const contracts: Map<string, ContractSummary> = new Map();

    // Process each CSV file
    for (const file of csvFiles) {
      const relativePath = path.relative(DWALLSTREET_ROOT, file);
      const contractName = getContractName(relativePath);

      console.log(`📖 Processing: ${contractName}`);

      try {
        const content = await fs.readFile(file, "utf-8");
        const records = parse(content, {
          columns: true,
          skip_empty_lines: true,
        });

        const methods = records as BMADMethod[];
        const contractMethods: string[] = [];

        for (const method of methods) {
          // Enrich with source information
          method.source_file = relativePath;
          method.contract_name = contractName;

          allMethods.push(method);
          contractMethods.push(method.method_name);
        }

        // Create contract summary
        contracts.set(contractName, {
          name: contractName,
          methods_count: methods.length,
          methods: [...new Set(contractMethods)],
          path: relativePath,
        });

        console.log(
          `   ✅ ${methods.length} methods from ${contractName}`
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          `   ❌ Error processing ${file}:`,
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
        );
      }
    }

    // Write main index
    console.log(`\n💾 Writing index files...\n`);

    // Create searchable index
    const index = {
      metadata: {
        total_methods: allMethods.length,
        total_contracts: contracts.size,
        generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        dwallstreet_root: DWALLSTREET_ROOT,
      },
      contracts: Array.from(contracts.values()).sort((a, b) =>
        a.name.localeCompare(b.name)
      ),
      methods: allMethods.sort((a, b) =>
        a.contract_name!.localeCompare(b.contract_name!)
      ),
      search_index: createSearchIndex(allMethods),
    };

    await fs.writeFile(OUTPUT_FILE, JSON.stringify(index, null, 2));
    console.log(`✅ Main index: ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);

    // Write summary
    const summary = {
      total_methods: allMethods.length,
      total_contracts: contracts.size,
      contracts: Array.from(contracts.entries()).map(([name, data]) => ({
        name,
        methods_count: data.methods_count,
        path: data.path,
      })),
    };

    await fs.writeFile(SUMMARY_FILE, JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
    console.log(`✅ Summary: ${SUMMARY_FILE}`);

    // Print statistics
    console.log("\n📊 Indexing Statistics:");
    console.log(`   Total Methods: ${allMethods.length}`);
    console.log(`   Total Contracts: ${contracts.size}`);
    console.log(`   Unique Method Names: ${new Set(allMethods.map((m) => m.method_name)).size}`);

    // Top 10 contracts by method count
    const topContracts = Array.from(contracts.values())
      .sort((a, b) => b.methods_count - a.methods_count)
      .slice(0, 10);

    console.log(`\n🏆 Top Contracts by Method Count:`);
    topContracts.forEach((c, idx) => {
      console.log(`   ${idx + 1}. ${c.name}: ${c.methods_count} methods`);
    });

    console.log("\n🎉 Indexing complete!");
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ Indexing failed:", error);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

/**
 * Create a search index for fast lookups
 */
function createSearchIndex(methods: BMADMethod[]): Record<string, number[]> {
  const index: Record<string, number[]> = {};

  methods.forEach((method, idx) => {
    // Index by method name
    const name = method.method_name.toLowerCase();
    if (!index[name]) index[name] = [];
    index[name].push(idx);

    // Index by contract
    const contract = (method.contract_name || "").toLowerCase();
    if (contract && !index[contract]) index[contract] = [];
    if (contract) index[contract].push(idx);

    // Index by keywords from description
    if (method.description) {
      const keywords = method.description
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter((w) => w.length > 3)
        .slice(0, 5);

      keywords.forEach((keyword) => {
        if (!index[keyword]) index[keyword] = [];
        index[keyword].push(idx);
      });
    }
  });

  return index;
}

// Run if called directly
main().catch(console.error);

const colors = {

  blue: '\x1b[34m',
  magenta: '\x1b[35m',
};

function log(message: string, color: keyof typeof colors = 'reset') {
  console.log(`${colors[color]}${message}${colors.reset}`);
}

function logSection(title: string) {
  console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(60));
  log(title, 'blue');
  console.log('='.repeat(60) + '\n');
}

function logError(message: string) {

  log(`⚠️  ${message}`, 'yellow');

/**
 * Test 3: Validation des montants
 */
async function testAmountValidation() {
  logTest('Validation des montants');

  try {
    // Test de conversion en wei
    const testCases = [
      { eth: 0.001, wei: '1000000000000000' },
      { eth: 1, wei: '1000000000000000000' },
      { eth: 0.1, wei: '100000000000000000' },
    ];

    testCases.forEach(({ eth, wei }) => {
      const calculated = (eth * 1e18).toString();
      if (calculated !== wei) {
        throw new Error(`Conversion incorrecte: ${eth} ETH devrait être ${wei} wei, obtenu ${calculated}`);
      }
      logSuccess(`Conversion OK: ${eth} ETH = ${wei} wei`);
    });

    recordTest('Validation des montants', true);
    return true;
  } catch (error: any) {
    logError(`Erreur de validation: ${error.message}`);
    recordTest('Validation des montants', false, error.message);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Test 4: Validation des adresses
 */
async function testAddressValidation() {
  logTest('Validation des adresses Ethereum');

  try {
    const validAddresses = [
      '0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b8D43C67B8c8B3E9C6',
      '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000',
    ];

    const invalidAddresses = [
      '0x123', // Trop court
      'not_an_address',
      '0xGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGG', // Caractères invalides
    ];

    // Vérifier les adresses valides
    validAddresses.forEach(addr => {
      const isValid = /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(addr);
      if (!isValid) {
        throw new Error(`Adresse valide rejetée: ${addr}`);
      }
      logSuccess(`Adresse valide acceptée: ${addr}`);
    });

    // Vérifier les adresses invalides
    invalidAddresses.forEach(addr => {
      const isValid = /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(addr);
      if (isValid) {
        throw new Error(`Adresse invalide acceptée: ${addr}`);
      }
      logSuccess(`Adresse invalide rejetée: ${addr}`);
    });

    recordTest('Validation des adresses', true);
    return true;
  } catch (error: any) {
    logError(`Erreur de validation: ${error.message}`);
    recordTest('Validation des adresses', false, error.message);
    return false;
  }
}

async function testSendTokensDryRun() {

    if (!/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(params.from)) {
      throw new Error('Adresse source invalide');

    if (BigInt(params.amount) <= 0) {

    logSuccess('Tous les paramètres sont valides');

    logSuccess(`À: ${params.to}`);
    logSuccess(`Montant: ${params.amount} wei`);
    logSuccess(`Chaîne: ${getChainName(params.chainId)} (${params.chainId})`);

    recordTest('Simulation d\'envoi', true);
    return true;

    recordTest('Simulation d\'envoi', false, error.message);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Résumé des tests
 */
function printTestSummary() {
  logSection('RÉSUMÉ DES TESTS');

  const passed = testResults.filter(t => t.passed).length;
  const failed = testResults.filter(t => !t.passed).length;
  const total = testResults.length;

  testResults.forEach(result => {
    if (result.passed) {
      logSuccess(`${result.name}: PASSÉ`);
    } else {
      logError(`${result.name}: ÉCHOUÉ - ${result.error}`);
    }
  });

  console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(60));
  log(`Total: ${total} tests`, 'blue');
  logSuccess(`Réussis: ${passed}`);
  if (failed > 0) {
    logError(`Échoués: ${failed}`);
  }
  console.log('='.repeat(60) + '\n');

  if (failed > 0) {
    logError('⛔ NE PAS UTILISER SUR MAINNET - DES TESTS ONT ÉCHOUÉ');
    logError('Corrigez les erreurs avant de continuer');
    return false;
  } else {
    logSuccess('✅ TOUS LES TESTS SONT PASSÉS');
    logWarning('⚠️  IMPORTANT: Ces tests ne garantissent pas que tout fonctionnera sur mainnet');
    logWarning('⚠️  Testez TOUJOURS sur testnet avec de vrais tokens de test d\'abord');
    logWarning('⚠️  Commencez avec de TRÈS PETITS montants sur mainnet');
    return true;
  }
}

import time
import requests
import json
import random

# --- CONFIGURATION DE SUTURE (Michael Lefebvre SI-L6) ---
ALCHEMIST_HUB_URL = "http://localhost:3001/api/energon/collect"
MAX_RETRIES = 3
THROTTLE_DELAY = 0.05  # 50ms de respiration entre les nodes MCP

def emit_energon_payload(worker_id, egn_value):
    """
    Envoie les deltas d'énergie vers le Hub avec validation Zero Trust.
    Nettoie les payloads pour éviter les erreurs 400.
    """
    payload = {
        "worker_id": worker_id,
        "egn_generated": round(egn_value, 4), # Évite les flottants infinis
        "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
        "signature": "ADAM-ALPHA-BRIDGE"
    }

    for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES):
        try:
            # Suture sémantique : On garantit l'envoi JSON pur
            response = requests.post(
                ALCHEMIST_HUB_URL, 
                json=payload,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                timeout=5
            )
            
            if response.status_code == 200:
                return True
            elif response.status_code == 400:
                print(f"⚠️ [SUTURE ERROR] Erreur 400 sur {worker_id}: {response.text}")
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ [CRITICAL] Échec de connexion au Hub pour {worker_id} (Tentative {attempt+1})")
        
        # Backoff pour laisser respirer le port 3001
        time.sleep(THROTTLE_DELAY * (attempt + 1))
    
    return False

def run_swarm_cycle(count=500):
    """
    Simule et envoie la production des 500 nodes MCP.
    """
    print(f"⚡ [CORE] Déploiement des {count} nodes MCP...")
    for i in range(count):
        node_id = f"mcp-node-{i+1:02d}"
        # Simulation rendement (1E = 1kWh)
        yield_val = 0.186 + (random.random() * 0.05)
        
        if emit_energon_payload(node_id, yield_val):
            print(f"🟢 {node_id} : {yield_val:.4f} EGN scellés.")
        else:
            print(f"🔴 {node_id} : Suture rompue.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Cycle infini pour maintenir la pression sur le p2pool
    try:
        while True:
            run_swarm_cycle(500)
            print("⏳ [REST] Attente du prochain cycle de 30s...")
            time.sleep(30)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n🛑 [SHUTDOWN] Arrêt du Guerrier Stateless par l'Architecte.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
ALCHEMIST CORTEX V3 - HYBRID PHASE 1+2 & PHASE 3 SEALING

Architecte : Michael Lefebvre (BLUE)

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

from datetime import datetime

from threading import Thread, Lock
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
import uuid
import asyncio
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager # <--- LA SUTURE EST ICI

# Setup logging
